user.title: Connect to Roraima
user.description: Enter the pairing code from your Roraima panel ({panel_url}). The panel shows the code only once, when you create the connection.

data_description.code: The code links this Home Assistant to your Roraima account. Do not share it.

devices.title: Devices shared with Roraima
devices.description: Roraima can control only the devices you select here, and receives no data about the others. You can change the selection at any time from the integration options.

data_description.devices: The list shows devices with switches, lights, locks, covers, fans, climate controls, valves, buttons or sensors, and entities that do not belong to a device. You can select up to 256.

reauth_confirm.title: New pairing code
reauth_confirm.description: Roraima no longer accepts the code of this Home Assistant. Create a new connection in your Roraima panel ({panel_url}) and enter the new code here.

data_description.code: The code links this Home Assistant to your Roraima account. Do not share it.

error.invalid_code: Roraima did not accept this code. Check that you copied it in full, or create a new connection in the panel.
error.cannot_connect: Roraima cannot be reached. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant and try again.
error.too_many_devices: You can share up to 256 devices with Roraima.
error.unknown: The connection could not be completed. Try again in a few minutes.
error.code_in_use: This code is already used by another Home Assistant, or this Home Assistant is already connected to Roraima with another code. Revoke the old connection in the panel and create a new one.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This Home Assistant is already connected to Roraima.
abort.reauth_successful: The new code has been saved and the connection to Roraima is active again.

create_entry.default: Home Assistant is connected to Roraima. The shared devices appear in your panel: {panel_url}

init.title: Devices shared with Roraima
init.description: Roraima can control only the devices you select here, and receives no data about the others. You can change the selection at any time from the integration options.

data_description.devices: The list shows devices with switches, lights, locks, covers, fans, climate controls, valves, buttons or sensors, and entities that do not belong to a device. You can select up to 256.

error.too_many_devices: You can share up to 256 devices with Roraima.

code_revoked.title: The connection to Roraima has been revoked
code_revoked.description: Roraima no longer accepts the pairing code of this Home Assistant, so the shared devices cannot be controlled. To connect again, create a new connection in your Roraima panel ({panel_url}) and enter the new code in the integration. If you no longer use Roraima, remove the integration.

instance_conflict.title: Another connection to Roraima is active
instance_conflict.description: Roraima refused the connection because its pairing code belongs to another Home Assistant, or because this Home Assistant is already connected with another code. The shared devices cannot be controlled through this connection. Revoke the old connection in your Roraima panel ({panel_url}), create a new one and enter the new code in the integration.
